style: Franco-Belgian clear-line adventure comic illustration for children aged nine, crisp even black outlines, flat bright colours with simple shadows, detailed precise backgrounds, old stone rooms and a great mountain lake; in indoor scenes the windows show only sky, water and distant mountains, never a building or a tower, expressive children with natural proportions, in the spirit of classic illustrated adventure albums. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles.
style_fiches: Franco-Belgian clear-line adventure comic illustration for children aged nine, crisp even black outlines, flat bright colours with simple shadows, expressive characters with natural proportions. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles. No scenery, no landscape.

personnages.elias: one eleven-year-old boy, the tallest of all, lanky with long arms and legs, light olive skin, dark brown eyes, short curly black hair, a pencil tucked behind his right ear, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching his elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright emerald green knitted sweater, a long bright yellow scarf, dark grey trousers and brown lace-up ankle boots, a small black notebook in his hand
personnages.maya: one ten-year-old girl of medium height, sturdy and lively, dark brown skin, bright dark eyes, black hair in two big round afro puffs, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching her elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright orange knitted sweater, a long bright yellow scarf, a dark grey skirt, white tights and brown lace-up ankle boots, a small patchwork cloth bag across her shoulder
personnages.tom: one nine-year-old boy, the smallest of all, thin and wiry, fair skin covered in freckles, green eyes, messy bright copper-red hair, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching his elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over bright turquoise dungarees far too big for him, rolled up at the ankles, and a white shirt, a long bright yellow scarf wound twice around his neck, small brown ankle boots, a folded wooden carpenter's rule sticking out of his chest pocket
personnages.kenza: one eleven-year-old girl, tall and slim, very upright with her chin lifted, warm light brown skin, dark brown eyes, very long glossy black hair in one thick braid down to her waist, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching her elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright fuchsia pink knitted sweater, a long bright violet scarf thrown over one shoulder, a dark grey skirt, dark grey tights and brown lace-up ankle boots, a large old iron key on a ribbon around her neck
personnages.sami: one ten-year-old boy, short and round with a soft tummy, light golden-tan skin, sleepy half-closed dark almond-shaped eyes, straight black hair flopping over his forehead, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching his elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright red knitted sweater, a long bright violet scarf, dark grey trousers and brown ankle boots with the laces undone, a small plump cushion with red and white stripes under his arm
personnages.nour: one ten-year-old girl, small and slim, very neat and upright, warm beige skin, large hazel eyes, shoulder-length curly dark brown hair held back by a white headband, wearing a short light grey wool cape with a small hood, reaching her elbows and fastened at the neck by one big round brass button, worn open over a bright royal blue knitted sweater, no scarf at all, a dark grey skirt, white knee socks and polished black buckled shoes, a small brown leather satchel across her shoulder
personnages.zora: one tall strong broad-shouldered woman of about fifty-five, brown weathered skin, dark eyes, short curly grey hair under a wide-brimmed dark green waxed hat, wearing a long dark green waxed coat over a thick cream sweater, brown trousers tucked into tall brown leather boots, a big iron ring of old keys hanging from her belt
personnages.idris: one very old small thin man of about eighty, dark brown skin with deep wrinkles, kind dark eyes, a bald head with a ring of short white hair, a short white beard, round brass spectacles pushed up on his forehead, wearing a rust-brown waistcoat with many small pockets over a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, baggy dark blue trousers and soft grey slippers, a large brass clock-winding key in his hand
personnages.ada: one small round brisk woman of about forty-five, light brown skin, lively dark eyes, black hair streaked with grey in a messy bun held by two pencils, wearing a long teal work coat with rolled-up sleeves, spotted with black ink, over a white blouse, a dark skirt and black ankle boots, fingertips black with ink, a long thin paintbrush in her hand

lieux.haute_lanterne: an old castle of pale grey stone built on a bare rock in the middle of a wide calm mountain lake, two long low wings with slate roofs and rows of small windows stretching to the left and to the right of a tall round tower shaped like a lighthouse, a glass lamp room glowing pale gold at the top of the tower, a small wooden landing stage at the foot of the rock, dark pine forests on the far shores and snowy peaks behind
lieux.ponton: a small wooden landing stage at the foot of a grey rock in a mountain lake, a long flight of worn stone steps climbing from it toward an old stone castle above, an iron mooring ring, a rough wooden bench, calm clear water all around
lieux.salle_horloges: a high vaulted stone hall used as a dining room, one whole wall covered from floor to ceiling with about a hundred clocks of every shape and size, pendulum clocks, round dials and tiny carriage clocks, their hands all pointing in different directions, their plain dials marked with small dots instead of numbers, two rows of long wooden tables and benches separated by one straight line of polished brass set into the stone floor, a tall wooden ladder leaning against the clock wall, tall windows at both ends
lieux.cour: a small paved courtyard at the foot of a tall round stone tower, closed on the left and on the right by the two wings of an old castle, one straight line of polished brass set into the paving stones and running across the whole courtyard, a long plain stone bench standing across this line so that the line cuts it exactly in the middle
lieux.couloir_impair: a long narrow castle corridor, its walls hung with faded blue cloth, a worn dark red carpet on the floor, a row of small round windows on one side, unlit brass lanterns hanging from hooks on the other side, one plain wooden door at each end, both exactly alike
lieux.perchoir: a round attic bedroom under the pointed roof of an old castle, thick slanting wooden beams, three small beds with yellow blankets, one big round window showing the sky and a mountain lake far below, a sturdy round wooden table in the middle, shelves crowded with rolled papers, old ink pots and brushes
lieux.taniere: a low vaulted stone bedroom at water level in an old castle, three small beds with violet blankets, one wide arched window just above a mountain lake, a workbench covered with old brass lantern parts, small panes of glass and tools, heaps of cushions on the stone floor
lieux.bibliotheque: a tall round library inside a stone tower, curved wooden shelves up to the ceiling filled with old books whose covers are all held shut by small leather straps, a spiral staircase of dark wood, reading desks with unlit brass lanterns, soft daylight falling from a round skylight
lieux.chambre_deux_fenetres: a small round stone workroom inside a tower, dusty and untouched for a very long time, two tall narrow windows exactly opposite each other, one long worktable in the middle covered with rolled parchments, ink pots, brass lantern parts and tools, three old silent clocks on the wall with plain dials marked with small dots instead of numbers, two wooden stools side by side

objets.moitie_levant: the right half of an old hand-drawn map on yellowed parchment, its left edge cut in a sharp zigzag of seven saw teeth, a few thin faded ink lines on it and no writing, lying flat and seen from the side, at a low angle
objets.moitie_couchant: the left half of an old hand-drawn map on yellowed parchment, its right edge cut in a sharp zigzag saw-tooth line, a few thin faded ink lines on it and no writing, half unrolled from a slim brass tube and seen from the side, at a low angle
objets.carte: two halves of an old parchment map pushed together on a wooden table along a zigzag saw-tooth cut, seen from the side, at a low angle
objets.luciole: a long narrow wooden boat painted dark green, with three plank seats and one long oar at the back, three wooden hoops arching over it from side to side, twelve small brass and glass lanterns hanging from the hoops
objets.lanterne: a small hand lantern of brass and glass with a ring handle, as big as a jam jar, one steady golden flame floating inside it without any candle
objets.lanterne_eteinte: a small hand lantern of brass and glass with a ring handle, as big as a jam jar, dark and unlit
objets.horloge_de_personne: a large round wall clock with a plain pale dial without any numbers, fifteen small notches around its rim and one single long black hand
objets.boutons: three big round coat buttons, one green, one orange and one turquoise
objets.cruche: a large round earthenware water jug with two handles
objets.coffre: an old wooden chest bound with iron bands, as big as a suitcase, its lid open
objets.corbeille: a big round wicker basket full of small round bread rolls
objets.metre: a folding wooden carpenter's rule, unfolded in a zigzag
objets.premiere_lanterne: a very small old lantern of dark brass and thick glass, no bigger than a pear, with two ring handles, one on each side
